player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''The Ithorian''') posted a [[Light]] list on DeckTech in June 2001.
description: The second part of my training decks.  A 30 card deck intended as a follow-up to Part 1 in order to teach space rules to new players.
cards: posted: Hear Me Baby, Hold Together (exact)
notes: Starting card as posted under 'Starting': Tatooine (Premiere Light system); it counts toward the total.
The post describes a 30-card training deck (a follow-up to Newbie Training Part 1), but the published list has 27 cards; kept as published.
The strategy mentions Quad Laser Cannon as one of the deck's starship weapons, but it is not in the posted list, so it is not added.
Posted 'Bo Shek' dested BoShek; 'Millenium Falcon' dested Millennium Falcon; 'X-Wing' dested X-wing (Premiere); 'Proton Torpedo' dested Proton Torpedoes; 'A Few Manuevers' dested A Few Maneuvers.
Same author posted a Dark Side deck with the same published title the same day (DeckTech 16975, already on the wiki as Scot Vales Newbie Training Part 2).
The same author posted a Dark teaching deck under the same title ([[Scot Vales Newbie Training Part 2]]); this Light one is titled with LS.
dest_title: Scot Vales Newbie Training Part 2 LS
